inputs.doc: E-027 EVAL wave 4: rolled corridor AUC for the SCALE cells — big34 768x12 seeds 0-2 (#295-297), big55 768x12x56-slot seeds 0-2 (#298-300, best forecast ratio ever: 0.14562 at s2), base55 576x8x56-slot seeds 0-1 (#301/302; s2 still training in #290) — against the e017 gate.
